scope: All 80 access=open rows in the loaded 186-model OCR catalog; additional known large open checkpoints checked despite legacy access=unknown. No model execution or repo changes.

reference_profile.status: declared modeling reference, not an observed uniform benchmark
reference_profile.rationale: Practical widely reported high-memory reference for dedicated OCR; not the weakest possible GPU and not a card that fits every model. H100-unspecified observations must retain board-variant uncertainty.
reference_profile.memory_policy: Preserve published supported precision; no silent quantization. Batch/image/context/output limits and runtime workspace must be explicit. GB/GiB and allocator reservations must not be conflated.

normalization_policy: Fit is not speed; no parameter/FLOPS-only performance regression or universal GPU scaling factor.
Label H100-normalized values modeled unless source reports the exact H100 SXM profile. Retain source hardware and measured pipeline in Details.
Separate warm single-page latency from peak batched throughput. Preserve input raster size, image token count, output token budget and stage/window exclusions.
Memory includes weights, vision activations, workspace, KV cache, CUDA graphs and runtime allocations; there is no universal 2x weight multiplier.
Do not auto-inherit benchmark accuracy after quantization, resizing, output truncation, CPU offload or changing model alias.
For hard exclusions show Requires multi-GPU / offload / separate quantized checkpoint, not zero pages/s.

runtime_sources.finding: Context, concurrent sequences, CUDA graphs and multimodal input budgets change memory. Profiling image hints do not resize actual images.
Official v1.0 vLLM deployment documentation gives 20GB memory requirement; not universal image-resolution fit.

Community operator reported HunyuanOCR1.5 Transformers eager path at ~33k image tokens exhausting even H200; capped image succeeds. Anecdotal runtime-specific warning, not an official universal memory requirement.
qwen3-vl-plus is listed as a hosted service alias; local checkpoint identity unverified.
